name: DWGZ — Fatica Domenicale
description:
DWGZ — Fatica Domenicale

Welcome to DWGZ (Determined Witty Gritty Zwifters) — a global crew of cyclists who show up with grit, humor, heart, and the kind of energy that lifts the whole group. Many of us have zwifted together for years, and some have taken those virtual connections IRL, organizing meetups around the world. DWGZ builds more than fitness — we build community, emotional endurance, and the kind of camaraderie that makes even the hardest efforts feel lighter through shared suffering.

Fatica Domenicale — Sunday suffering, Italian-style — is all about the vert. This isn't a steady-state endurance session — it's a hard, hand-picked climbing route we're setting out to conquer together, gradient by gradient. Finish the course and earn your DWGZ jersey — one of two unlock rides on our weekly calendar, alongside Saturday's Hot Hundo, our 100-mile test of grit.

Whether you're chasing the jersey, sharpening your climbing legs, or just want to suffer alongside people who'll cheer you up the last kilometer, this ride is for you.

Ride Categories 🚴 B Category – 3.2–4.0 w/kg 🚴 C Category – 2.8–3.2 w/kg 🚴 D Category – 2.0–2.6 w/kg

Expect steep pitches, patient pacing, and a welcoming group from yellow beacon to sweep. Every pocket of the ride is built on teamwork, connection, and that signature DWGZ vibe.

DWGZ rides run seven days a week at 6:05 AM Eastern (US) — each one an opportunity to build strength, connection, and global community.
Clip in, chase the KOM, and climb into the week with us.

ADVANCED CATEGORY = 650+
CATEGORY RANGE 1 = 0-159 | 160-269 | 270-389 | 390-509 | 510-649

Please note that in order to enter the Advanced category, you will need the following:

name: MGCC Pretzel
description:
Sunday morning Pretzel is a MGCC Zwift tradition for the winter season!
Join the group as we tackle Watopia's Pretzel.

Pace: We'll go at a steady pace on the flats, and hit the big climbs a
little harder. We'll do our best to regroup at the top of the climbs,
depending on the mood of the group. Steady aerobic on the flats (Yellow
beacon will do 3.0 - 3.5 W/kg) then on the hills we will increase the pace
to a bit above threshold (4.0-4.4 W/kg).

The groups may break-up on the climbs, but try to hang on to a wheel with
similar ability. This is not a race, but it is not an easy ride either. You
are encouraged to stay with the leader; don't count on a sweeper.

Looking forward to riding with you!

For more info, please join the MGCC Zwift Facebook Group:
https://www.facebook.com/groups/323925517987763/

name: Into the Red Race by RELENTLESS
description:
Into the Red Race by RELENTLESS

WHAT IS CATEGORY ENFORCEMENT?
Category Enforcement will prevent Zwifters from entering a category they are not eligible for. Our goal is to increase fairness in racing while promoting a fun environment.

HOW DOES IT WORK?
The race will be mass start and allow all racers to push themselves to the next level.  Each race will change routes and worlds each week but will always be 25 km.  These “different” race finishes will require tactics and planning to know when and where to play your move.

You must be opted-in on Zwift.com & ZwiftPower.com to be counted for race results.
We highly encourage A racers to follow Zwift eRacing Ruleset.

Dual recording of trainer & power meter, and recent weigh-in based on Zwift Transparency rules recommended–we reserve the right to ask for this information to verify outstanding performances.

name: 6Points Challenges Group Sunday Training Ride
description:
Please look out for our 6Points Challenges group training rides every week, searching #6Points for our rides on the Zwift website or on Zwift Companion.

You should ride as a group, following the instructions of the yellow beacon ride leader and Red beacon sweeper for any sprints, intervals and spicy segments, regrouping after each when requested. Our lap or distance-limited group rides also have a closing minirace, to start from behind the yellow beacon. The fence may be used to control starts for miniraces. Our 1-hour rides don’t close with a minirace.

Our in-real-life (IRL) Reverence 6Points Mallorca real-life cycling events, with Title sponsor Reverence Hotels, are ridden around Mallorca and raise money for charities in Mallorca. 6Points has already raised over €300,000 for its chosen charities.

6Points Mallorca is a 3-day ride around the whole of the beautiful island of Mallorca, covering a little over 400 kms, climbing 7500 metres and touching the four compass extremities, as well as the highest and lowest points of Mallorca - hence the name 6Points. See https://6pointschallenges.com/ for more about our in-real-life events. We also run events in Ibiza / Formentera and Menorca.

Just as for our Zwift group rides, 6Points Challenges are NOT races. They are opportunities to participate in a challenging ride, in one of several pace groups, with like-minded cyclists, to enjoy Mallorca’s diverse beauty and the friendship and camaraderie of fellow riders. 6Points supports sustainable cycling, whose riders care for the environment and practise courtesy to fellow road users.

The 6Points Zwift group ride

As we expect our IRL riders to be able to ride up to 50 miles at or around a 15mph average, such steady riding members should be comfortable with Zwift Categories C and D. Beacon leaders communicate via Zwift on-screen messaging (always) and/or Discord (sometimes) via your headset to vary the pace to allow for sprints, intervals and optionally a mini-race towards the end of the rides, with regrouping after each sprint. Make as much use of drafting as you can, for more effective sprinting and rest intervals.

During the ride, the beacon will announce any sprints, and the ride will finish with a minirace to the end of the ride, between 3kms and 8kms depending on the course.

Results (the finishing order, relevant to the minirace which we will all start together) can be seen at the end of the ride on screen, and we publish your results on zwiftpower.com too.

All bikes and Power-Ups (PU) are allowed, but it is better not to use TT bikes to ensure drafting. Please add 6Points (X) to your Zwift name to allow your ride presence to be recognised, where X is your own ride category. Categories in Zwift are related to your Functional Threshold Power (FTP); use your FTP and then divide by your weight in kg to get the w/kg that applies to you.

On this ride series, all riders are welcome, but bear in mind that rides are designed for either:

Category D: 2 W/kg to 2.5 W/kg FTP. The beacon leader will ride to 2.5w/kg pace average or below.
Category C: 2.6 W/kg to 3.2 W/kg FTP. The beacon leader will ride to 3.2w/kg pace average or below.

PLEASE NOTE: Strava data for our rides must be open (not private or hidden). Please use a heart rate monitor so that we can monitor correlated power and heart rate to help assure fair riding.

You can use our 6Points Discord channel to talk to each other at https://discord.gg/bPsQCNh.

Please see the 6Points Zwift page at https://6pointschallenges.com for more, including how we support our chosen charities.

https://6pointschallenges.com/

#6Points

PS You can check for any of our rides (group rides, TTs and races) that have been scheduled at any time (up to a week ahead) by searching at https://www.zwift.com/events/tag/6points or on Companion.

For those we run for Glasgow Green Cycle Club, GGCC search on https://www.zwift.com/events/tag/ggcc or on Companion.

For more about specific Zwift courses for our events, see the Zwift Companion schedule, and also https://zwiftinsider.com/ where there is a wealth of information about all things Zwift.

Ride On!!

name: ZZRC Wind Down Sub 2
description:
Welcome to our ZZRC Wind Down Sub 2. This is a group ride, not a race, where we encourage riding together.

Our rides are open to all riders, the category enforcement merely allows us to ensure a safe and quality ride for you the riders and for our group.

In 2015 ZZRC was founded and are one of the oldest established clubs on Zwift .

YELLOW BEACON will pace between 1.7-1.9 on the ride , with a possible increase of watts on inclines or sprints , but the average for the whole ride will be sub 2 .

We strongly promote group riding so on most of our rides we will use the Fence to help encourage that. Using a fence ensures that the ride is not over paced .

In the event of falling off the back of the main group , you will need to pace well over group pace to bridge the gap and catch .

This is where our awesome ZZRC sweeps and Ride Buddies will help you return to group using their draft. They will give you clear encouraging instructions to aid this process .

Our crew are a caring bunch who dedicated a lot of hours to this club , but want you to have the best ride experience on Zwift

You will be fully supported and encouraged throughout the ride by the Leader, Sweeps and Ride Buddies .

Our rides do not allow the use of TT Bikes as they do not draft and will require you to push harder on the ride, and in these instances our Sweeps will not be able to help you .

Mountain bikes operate very similarly, minimum draft so more watts (effort) will be required for the ride and any chase backs to group .

All our rides have a 30 minute late join feature which allows you to rejoin if you have technical issues or you find yourself out of the group in the early stages of the ride. Using this feature SHOULD teleport you back into the main group with our YELLOW BEACON .

We love to have a chat on our rides so join us on our dedicated discord channel for our sub 2
https://discord.gg/RJ3dhbjCEp

TOP TIPS
1) Stay close to the ride leader (or just in front on climbs), don’t let a gap form and the elastic snap!
2) Stay away from the Fence – We don’t like to fry anyone
3) Most important of all . . . HAVE FUN AND ENJOY THE RIDE.

#zzrc

Don’t forget to join our ZZRC-We Pace Not Race Facebook page and our club on the companion app

name: HerD Beginner Races
description:
Where do you go to try racing or to grow a little better with your racing craft… Herd Beginner Races is set up to provide you with that opportunity by using Zwift Racing Scores (ZRS) with bandwidths that are set up so you’re competing with people of similarities and routes that enable you to challenge yourself and grow with racing. Our pens are set up so you're racing with others of similar abilities. Zwift will recommend your pen in blue; you can race in a higher up pen but it's not recommended.

Each week HBR races will have a different focus; racing on a flat route, rolling/undulating with a small climbs, and a route that is commonly used in many Zwift racing events. In addition, the last race of the month will be Tick-Tock so that you can monitor your performance.

name: NonSequitur Social Splash
description:
Welcome to the NonSequitur Social Splash! A banded ride for the absolute beginner,
the recovering injured or any Zwifter looking for a relaxing beginner ride that hits the
sweet spot of off beat & entertaining then this is the ride for you. What will you find on
this ride you ask...bad jokes, typos, riding tips, encouragement but most importantly a
place to build your abilities and confidence.

name: NPRC - Run Every Day Powered By NoblePro
description:
Come and join the fastest growing running club on Zwift.  With a choice of 5 or 10k you can pick your distance. Whether you are a beginner or experienced runner come and join us, you can run at whatever pace you like, it’s not a race unless you want it to be!

Each day is a different route and as new routes are released the courses will change to allow you to bag that badge.

You will run in our in game NPRC jersey and if you complete the event you get to keep it to wear wherever you like.

We also hold special events where you can win an actual jersey to wear in real life.

NPRC Facebook – We have a facebook group where you can join and talk about all things running.  Share your stories and get help and advice.

https://www.facebook.com/groups/1223724692417314/

NoblePro: - We are a team focused on elevating running through our treadmills and digital platforms. We create treadmills loved by runners and the wider running community for quality engineered hardware features and advanced software integration to give you the freedom to train with the apps you love.
https://www.noble-pro.com/

Kinni:- In a fitness world where treadmill bluetooth integration can be a confusing place, we aim to provide you with the ability to effortlessly connect. You can run structured treadmill workouts, connect and integrate with your favourite bluetooth fitness apps such as Zwift, Rouvy, Kinomaps and many more. We are focused on progress and advancement in integration, connectivity and control.
https://kinni.co/https://kinni.co/devices/ - To see if your treadmill is compatible to link to Zwift.

name: Ascend Together - A Zwift Climbing Adventure
description:
Join forces with Ascenders and Mountain Massif Club for a weekly tradition: Ascend Together. Each week, we’ll tackle a fresh climbing challenge on Zwift, rotating routes to keep the adventure alive and spirits high. Some weeks, we'll even target special Route Badges — perfect for those climbs that seem a little too daunting when tackled solo.

This ride is open to everyone in the Zwift community because, frankly, we love your company. Expect a steady pace around 2.5 w/kg, designed to keep the group together and the energy strong. Fellow Zwift Clubs are warmly invited to co-lead and/or ride alongside us — after all, this is a celebration of everything we love about Zwift: the rides, the climbs, the camaraderie, the positivity and the community.

No matter your club, team, or solo status, we welcome you to make Ascend Together part of your weekly schedule. Let’s create a ride to remember — every single week. See you on the climb!

name: Zwift Beginners Ride with Project Sloth
description:
Welcome to our Project Sloth group ride.

This ride will be banded to allow people of all abilities to join.

What is banded? Banded allow us to create group rides where we all stay together as a group no matter what power output you're doing. the only requirement is that you don't stop peddling.

Project SLOTH aims to create rides that are beginner friendly, good for recovery riders and chunky people like me.

If you have any questions during the ride, please feel free to ask and we will do our best to answer them.

Use this event however you want, top up your mileage for the week, recovery run, workouts, Walk/Run Intervals or use it for PB bashing (and get the best support squad around cheering you on) or come along for a natter with other members. Please join us for the ZLDR WARMUP and come have some fun.

ZLDR is a group of diverse people, from speed demons to walkers, from people just getting to their first 5k to ultra runners. name: The HERD Sunday Endurance
description:
Welcome to the Herd’s Sunday Endurance Ride.

This is not a race, but a long ride at a steady pace with a big group. We ride together for two hours at a pace of 1.5 w/kg on the flats and 2.0 w/kg on climbs.

All riders are welcome and appreciated. Whether you’re brand-new to Zwift or have been on the platform for a decade, we want to ride with you.

Routes change weekly and we ask that you please follow the ride leader’s instructions. The ride leader can turn on the fence if needed to control the pace, but we are always better working as a team. Please respect the leader's pace and stay with the yellow beacon.

Stronger riders are encouraged to fall back and help sweep the riders struggling in the back, rather than flying off the front. And if you fall off the pace give a shout and someone will fall back to help bring you back to the group.

name: RO4H Sunday Social Spin
description:
Welcome to the RO4H Sunday Social Spin!
The RO4H Sunday Social Spin is a friendly, supportive group ride hosted by the Ride On 4 Health community. We aim to create a casual, respectful atmosphere that welcomes everyone—from seasoned Zwifters to first‑time group ride participants.
Pace & Expectations
Our overall average pace is typically 18–20 MPH (28–32 KPH). Terrain will naturally influence speed:
- Flats may run slightly faster within the peloton
- Climbs will remain sub‑2 W/kg
- Routes are usually flat, and we strive to be a no‑drop ride
This pace is recovery for some and a solid effort for others, so riders should be prepared to meet the average and stay with the leader’s peloton to enjoy the draft. This is a social ride, not a race—we don’t chase flyers, and flyers are free to fly.
Sweep Support
Sweepers are on hand to help anyone who drifts off the back. Their goal is to ensure no one rides alone unless they prefer to. They may help riders bridge back to the peloton or form a second pace group for a more comfortable experience.
Join the Fun
Come along for the RO4H Sunday Social Spin—you’ll likely break a sweat, hear a few dad jokes, and definitely have some fun. Welcome to the RO4H family!

eventSubgroups.name: RO4H Sunday Social Spin (D)
eventSubgroups.description:
Welcome to the RO4H Sunday Social Spin. 

The RO4H Sunday Social Spin is a social group ride hosted by the Ride On 4 Health community where a friendly, casual, supportive, and respectful atmosphere embraces everyone from the most seasoned Zwifter to the first-time group ride participant.   

The pace varies depending on terrain but will have an overall average pace of about 18-20 MPH/28-32 KPH for the ride. The pace on the flats sections will be slightly faster in the peloton and will remain sub 2 W/KG on climbs. We typically ride flat routes and try to be a no-drop ride but ultimately this pace is a recovery pace for some and a great effort for others. You should be prepared to meet the average pace and strive to stay in the ride leaders peloton to benefit from the group draft effect.  Being a social ride, we don’t chase flyers — flyers are free to fly — and this ride is certainly not a race (#zwiftisalwaysarace). 

Sweepers are available to assist those off the back. We do not want anyone to ride alone unless they choose. The sweepers will variably help riders bridge to the peloton or form a second pace group so riders do not ride alone.  

So come along for the RO4H Social Spin — you'll almost certainly break a sweat, undoubtedly hear a few dad jokes, and might even have some fun.

name: Rhino Upgrade Express
description:
Join the Rhino Upgrade Express every Sunday for a relaxed 90-minute endurance ride designed to build your base, collect kilometres and make progress on your Zwift bike upgrades.										
BEFORE YOU JOIN THE PEN..										
"The event defaults everyone to a TT bike — and there’s a reason!
Before entering the pen, equip the bike you want to upgrade. Once you join the event and Zwift switches you to the TT bike, your previously equipped bike will continue receiving upgrade credit for the distance, elevation and ride time you complete during the event. So pick your upgrade bike FIRST, then join the pen."										
										
										
The ride is banded, so nobody gets dropped. Ride your Zone 2, chat with the group, collect XP and let the kilometres pile up										
No racing. No chasing. Just 90 minutes of steady Sunday miles with the Rhinos.										
Pick your bike. Join the train. Upgrade while you ride.										
Interested in team racing? We do ZRL, WTRL TTT, and Club Ladder. Join us! https://discord.com/invite/wPD4HJ6										7

name: WOW - High Speed Ride on TT bikes with draft
description:
The WOW Zwift events are the fastest way to collect happy miles while meeting exceptional riders/ friends on ZWIFT. While you will be assigned a fast TT bike with a fast wheel set in draft mode, you will still be upgrading your bike of choice selected in your garage before starting the ride.

Our Es (Emerging Riders) will leave the pen first with a rough power range of 1.3-1.7 W/kg – the group will travel around 32-34km/h. Ds (Development of ‘Drecovery’ 😊) will follow them next and hold the group together within D power limits (1.6-2.0 W/kg) – expected speed is 35-37km/h. Several minutes later C’s (Crusaders) will start and keep riding as one unit guided by the power range of 2.1-2.6 W/kg that will deliver speed between 39 and 41km/h… Further several minutes later the B train (Bombers) starts unleashing their watts within the range of 2.7-3.3 W/kg creating a 42-44km/h draft zone. Several minutes later the A magician group (Aliens) take off and rapidly make up the delays from the groups starting ahead through their 3.4-4.5 power range generating a group speed of 45-48 km/h. When will the groups catch each other? Every catch will be an opportunity to celebrate the ONE WOW FAMILY!

All groups will see each other, transfers between the groups on the go will be possible. The ride leaders will help make those transitions smooth.

WOW is a no drama, full fun ride!

Double draft is on and the fast TT bikes will be drafting!

name: The Zwifty Fifty with DZR
description:
**The Zwifty Fifty: When 25 is Too Little and 100 is Too Much**

DZR brings to you the Goldilocks of Zwift racing intensity and endurance balance. With weekly races at about 50 km, the races are not too short and intensive to build stamina, and not too long and time-consuming to actually get done. They are just right. And they are on every Sunday at 14:45 CET | 8:45 AM EST.

To add to the fun and keep a high intensity throughout the race, we have included bonus second sprints. These sprints are on flats when the finish is on a KOM and on KOMs when the finish is flat.

No powerups, no zpower, no TT bikes, HRM enforced.

For all the details, including stage information, bonus sprints, rules, and registration links, visit the official website for The Zwifty Fifty at http://dzrracingseries.com/the-zwifty-fifty/

Ride within yourself, look out for others, and enjoy the roll.

We’re more than a club — we’re a global community of riders who support each other, grow together, and celebrate every ride, whether it’s a grind, a badge hunt, or a race. Join us on Discord, connect with fellow riders, and be part of something bigger.

name: 3R Endurance Steady Ride
description:
3R Chase Endurance Ride

Join us for an exhilarating 3R Group Ride Event, where teamwork isn’t just encouraged, it’s essential!

This description does not include the C endurance ride, this is as usual a normal C endurance ride.

In this Chase Endurance Ride, we embark on a 100km journey, following the same course as our Steady State B group. The aim? To gradually close the gap and merge with the Steady State B Group around the 80km mark, setting the stage for an exciting final stretch.

This ride is about group effort and shared responsibility. We expect each rider to contribute, taking turns on the front with pulls of approximately 4.5-5.0 w/kg. Remember, it’s a chase, not a free ride, so we kindly ask that you join in the spirit of collective effort rather than just drafting throughout.

When our group catches up with the Steady State B group, it’s a chance to mix things up! If you’re feeling strong, keep up the pace with the A group. Alternatively, if you’re in the mood for a more relaxed ride, feel free to settle in with the B group.

Remember, this isn’t a race, but a part of our #ProStyleTraining series, designed to support your training goals in a fun, social setting. We love a bit of friendly banter and encourage you to share your experiences and feedback on our Facebook page at https://www.facebook.com/groups/ClubWorldBicycleRelief/. Let’s ride, raise, race and enjoy together with #Team3R.

This is not a race so please follow the leader beacon's (Yellow) instructions and if you are feeling strong, please help the keeper beacon (Red) to assist other riders back to the pack. We welcome good banter and aim to create a fun, social atmosphere for your training. name: Pride Run
description:
Join with members of the LGBTQ+ community as we stride with Pride! 

Runs are hosted by LGBTQ Zwifters Club and we invite you to join our weekly rainbow run! In some runs you will find a leader to make it social and help keep you motivated. If you are in training for a duathlon or triathlon, you can even join a Pride Ride before your run, since runs are scheduled 30 min after each Pride ride ends. name: The Mountain Massif
description:
Every great race has a defining climb.

This event is built for riders who thrive when the road tilts skyward. Expect a demanding route featuring sustained ascents, decisive hills, and relentless terrain that rewards patience, tactical awareness, and exceptional endurance.

The strongest rider doesn’t always win—but the smartest one often does.

Conserve your energy in the wheels. Read the race. Cover the moves that matter. Then, when the gradient bites and your rivals begin to fade, commit without hesitation.

The decisive attack will come. The question is whether you’ll be the one launching it—or chasing it.

There are no easy kilometres here. Every climb is an opportunity to gain time. Every descent is a chance to recover. Every decision shapes the final result.

When the summit is in sight, hesitation is the difference between victory and watching the podium ride away.

Race with discipline. Climb with conviction. Finish with nothing left to give.

Rules:
Heart Rate monitor required and Zwift Power for official results.

More information:
For more information check out the Mountain Massif website www.mountainmassif.com, follow on Instagram @mountain_massif, Facebook @mountainmassif and join our Zwift Club, by clicking the following link https://www.zwift.com/clubs/mountainmassif/home

name: Level Racing Chase Race
description:
Chase race with riders starting in 4 pens based on CE categories A, B, C, D.  Handicap times are applied between pens.  D cat riders leave first, followed by C, then B and finally A.  The object for each group is to work together to chase and catch the groups ahead of you.  The D cat group will try to stay in front of the other groups.  If the handicaps are correct, then all teams will come together somewhere in the final kilometer,  As this happens, the race changes from working in groups to an individual race, where the first across the line is the winner

To help you chat and work together with others in your pen, Level offer a Discord voice service.  You are welcome to use this if you want.  It’s equally ok to race without it and listen to your music or whatever else you do when racing.  For those who want to use Discord voice, you can join the Level Chase Race Discord server here.  Make sure you join the correct voice channel for your pen!

High Performance Racing Towels are proud to present - Turbo Ten!

On Sunday, take part in ten back to back races on the shortest routes in Zwift!

1 - Downtown Dolphin (2.03km)
2 - The Bel Lap (2.04km)
3 - Macaron (2.6km)
4 - Glasgow Crit Circuit (3.26km)
5 - Glasgow Reverse (4.21km)
6 - LaGuardia Loop (4.3km)
7 - Duchy Estate (4.7km)
8 - LaGuardia Loop Reverse (5.2km)
9 - Queen's Highway (5.6km)
10 - ZG25 Climb Champs (5km)

Riders are categorised into 5 groups using their Compound Score (NB: To calculate your compound score multiply your 90 day best 5 minute power watts by watts oer kilo, eg 200*2=400 if your best 5 minute power is 200w as a 100kg rider)

Category A: 1700 and above
Category B: 1200-1700
Category C: 900-1200
Category D: 600-900
Category E: 0-600

Riders will all start together, but you will be able to see which riders are in your category by the letter on their jersey.

Big Heads and Boost Power ups will be in action! Every rider will receive two boost power ups in the pen (which give you a 1 second boost of power). Use them wisely!

Riders must be using a Smart Trainer, Smart Bike or Power Meter and have a Heart Rate Monitor paired to join the events.

Overall standings are taken from your overall time across all the stages that you take part in, see the results here: https://zwiftpower.com/league.php?id=3345

To keep up with latest events and news, please join the club here: https://www.zwift.com/clubs/389fbdf0-9cd7-4b42-8f76-4d1b6af240ae

name: BMTR Short Adventure
description:
The BMTR Short Adventure focuses on enjoying a fun group experience while cycling at an endurance pace.

Our ride leaders are experienced, friendly, and ready to ensure you have a great time. They'll help keep the ride fun and at the right pace for your group!

This event is mainly about "Zone 2 Endurance" riding, which means we’ll be cycling at a comfortable pace. Each category has an average watts per kilogram (w/kg) range designed to keep most riders in their "Zone 2 Endurance" or low "Zone 3 Tempo" zones. Just choose the category that fits your Functional Threshold Power (FTP) or the one that Zwift assigns to you, and you’ll be all set for an enjoyable ride!


**Join Us on Any or All of the Following Platforms!**
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/groups/bmtrzwiftclub
Strava: https://www.strava.com/clubs/BMTRZwiftClub
Zwift: https://www.zwift.com/clubs/BMTR/home
Instagram: https://instagram.com/bmtrclub

**To Find All Weekly BMTR Events**
https://bmtr.events

name: Phoenix Rising Tronathon (Banded)
description:
Tronathon is a social, supportive banded ride. We help riders build strength, endurance and comfort in riding hills. We also mix in a healthy amount of entertainment and distraction. Tronathon was established in 2020 to help riders earn their Tron bike while also earning the Avid or Masochist badges. This continues to be our goal. All are welcome whether you are a newer cyclist, question if you can reach the summit of one of Zwift's hills, currently hate climbing, or just want to support other riders. Everyone has a story about their first Alpe, Tron quest or the climbing gains they've made and we want to hear yours. We are a fun loving community and welcome all who might want to join us!

For more information on all our weekly events, join our club Phoenix Rising on Zwift Companion.

Join us on Discord during the ride: https://discord.gg/mNMva8ekJR
Check us out on Facebook https://www.facebook.com/groups/615972979730125/

name: HPL Cycling Provincial+ Endurance Ride
description:
HPL Cycling is the premiere masters cycling team based out of Saskatchewan, Canada. Check us out at https://www.hplcycling.ca.

Each week we will ride at an endurance pace with focus and control. Riding as a disciplined group, sticking with the yellow beacon is the goal. On occasion your ride leaders may open up the group to sprinting, once the sprint is complete, please regroup on the yellow beacon.   We challenge you to complete the full two hours. If you complete the 2 hours, you will unlock the HPL Cycling kit!

The ride is speed based versus W/kg based. As a result the speeds will increase and decrease with the terrain of the course but effort will remain fairly consistent. The effort required to hold each categories indicated average speed is specific to the individual so choose the category that fits your ability. Each categories overall average speed is indicated in their descriptions.

Once you complete the ride we recommend cooling off with some stretching from Dynamic Cyclist.  Head to https://new.dynamiccyclist.com and use coupon code HPLCYCLING for 25% off of their programming.

#HPLCycling
https://www.zwift.com/events/tag/HPLCycling

name: 3R Racing
description:
This RACE is brought to you by 3R to help draw attention to our charity partners. One example is how Buffalo Bikes (provided by the charity WBR for £100/each) can benefit the world's transport needy families.
Expect this RACE to be highly competitive across all CATs. In order to make the racing as fair as possible, racers on zPower, lacking heart rate monitors, riding an an inappropriate category, or riding very unrealistically may be disqualified.
Final results will be available on zwiftpower.com. We hope that everyone gets a great workout and has some good fun in this part of 3R’s #prostyletraining offering. #rideon #RideRaceRaise

name: Catrina's Ladies Social Ride
description:
I would like to invite ALL women to join this Social Ride & Social exchange! Our goals during the ride are as follows:

1. Recovery from Training
2. Socialization with other women riders (via Catrina’s Social Ride channel or Group Texting in Zwift)
3. Support, Development, & Growth toward becoming better cyclists/athletes in a nurturing group setting
4. Teaching skills in the Zwift program course (Riding in Groups, Draft Effect, Racing Technique, Rolling Cadence, etc.)
5. To have FUN!

This is a Social Ride, with a goal of keeping everyone together, in order to build on group riding skills. This ride is not a "race", although we may practice racing techniques. At all times, we will try to have 1-2 Ladies on the ride to assist the women on the course. Some weeks will be in workout mode but always at z2 efforts. If you yearn for opportunities to meet & socialize with other women cyclists who are passionate about riding, we strongly encourage you to join us!

Ultimately our goal is to enhance your riding experience, while having FUN!

name: Herd Classics #3 - Herd of Mountain Goats
description:
Herd Classics: six weeks, six different races.

This year Herd Racing is taking all their best races and putting them in one big competition.
Take on legendary Zwift courses while going on a trip down memory lane. Each week brings
us a new challenge and each week we will crown an overall and Herd Racing champion in
all categories. For the hardcore racers that will be joining us each week there is also a Herd
Classic Championship.

Week 1: The Stampede
Our ITT format, pick your best TT-bike to set the fastest time possible.

Week 2: Herd Winter Racing (also known as Herd Beginner Racing)
A mass start scratch race. Find your group and race them to the finishline.

Week 3: Herd of Mountain Goats
Climbing, lots and lots of climbing.

Week 4: Bullseye Point Race
First across the line points racing. Beat everyone to the line to score the most points.

Week 5: Climbers Gambit
Our Hill Climb event. Only your time on the climb segment counts.

Week 6: Herd Summer Racing League
It’s not really summer anymore, but we’re always in for a good FTS points race.

As a part of the trip down memory lane we’re letting everyone weigh in on the courses that
will be used. So if you want your vote to count join the Herd Racing facebook page:
https://www.facebook.com/groups/zHerdRacing

name: Team DRAFT Sunday Race
description:
Welcome to the Sunday Race brought to you by Team DRAFT!
We encourage that all participants head over to zwiftpower.com and register. For more information see: https://zwiftinsider.com/zwiftpower-signup/ Riders who have not completed the Zwiftpower registration will not be included in the official race results. We also ask that your Zwift activities be saved publicly, and that you open and maintain a Strava account to allow for organizer analysis. Any rider exhibiting questionable performance during a the race may be disqualified.

RULES:
- No zPower riders.
- Heart rate monitors mandatory for all categories
- 5min and 20min CEVAZ limits apply. Riding in the wrong category will lead to disqualification.

RACE CATEGORIES:
A: 4.0 W/kg to 5.0 W/kg
B: 3.2 W/kg to 3.99 W/kg
C: 2.5 W/kg to 3.19 W/kg
D: Under 2.49 W/kg

name: Zwift Crit Racing Club - Times Square Circuit
description:
It's Crit time! Come and join in the fun on a number of multi-lap short routes. Get ready to dig deep and push to the finish line!

What is Racing Score?

Racing Score is an intuitive system that replaces the traditional categories (A - D) with a 0-1000 scale to reflect your current level, considering various metrics like race performances and power. This score helps Zwift recommend the most competitive band to race in, ensuring a fun, rewarding, and exciting experience as you track your progression throughout your Zwift racing adventures.

WHAT IS ZWIFT POWER? For further information on connecting to Zwift Power check out this support page: https://support.zwift.com/en_us/connecting-to-zwiftpower-SyldRc_4H

Please note; for your results to show up in Zwift Power you must be using a Heart Rate Monitor (HRM) and be riding on a smart trainer, smart bike, or using a power meter.

name: Invictus Games Foundation Sunday Social
description:
Hosted by the Invictus Games Foundation. Below the link to the sign up for the event:

https://reg.resport.io/s/step1.jsp?r=4747885851705344

Join our social ride led by members of the Invictus Games international community of serving military personnel and veterans who use cycling to recover from injury.

A sub-2.0 w/kg (Cat D) weekly group ride with the goal of keeping the group together. This event is open to any ability including those who use handcycles, recumbents, trikes, tandems and standard bikes.

Follow the ride leader's instructions and stay as close to the beacon as possible. If you're feeling strong, please use your abilities to help pull fellow riders back to the pack.

There will be inspirational chat and a fun, social atmosphere for your training. Please ask questions - about using sport for recovery, training, set-up and the experiences of our Invictus family.

It is not a race. Use the draft.

Late joiners allowed.

If you are a member of the WIS community and happy to let the group know, please write [*IGF*] after your name on your profile.
For more information about the Invictus Games Foundation please go to https://invictusgamesfoundation.org/

name: RO4H Banded Rookie Group Ride
description:
Welcome to the RO4H Banded Rookie Group Ride! This relaxed, supportive event is designed to help Zwifters of all levels learn the basics in a friendly, completely judgment-free environment.
Whether you are new to indoor riding, a seasoned outdoor rider new to virtual cycling, or just unsure about Zwifting terms, you belong here.
Many of our riders are absolute beginners. To jump in, just click that orange square with the white plus sign to sign up, and we'll see you at the starting line!
The "Rubberband" is On: This is a banded ride, meaning the game uses a virtual elastic band to keep the group together. No matter how hard or light you pedal, you will stay right with the group. You literally cannot get dropped unless you stop pedaling!
Zero Stress, Total Support: Use this ride to ask questions, practice drafting, figure out your screen setup, or recover. There are no silly questions here.
Join the Conversation (Or Just Watch): Our steady, connected pace makes it easy to type into the chat. If you're working too hard to type, don't worry—feel free to just read along and enjoy the company!
Rookie Tip: We highly recommend downloading the Zwift Companion App on your phone before the ride. It makes chatting, steering, and viewing the map much easier while you pedal. Grab it at zwift.com.
Come join the RO4H Rookie Ride—let's learn, spin, and have fun together. We can't wait to ride with you!

name: NoPinz R3R - 60km Race
description:
Welcome to this NoPinz R3R Race. The rules are simple....
Please use ZwiftPower's Minimum Category on your profile for race entry.
Cats A, and B will require a power source (power meter or smart trainer) and heart rate monitor.
Cat C will require power source (power meter or smart trainer) and heart rate monitor for podium spots.
Podium finishers in Cat A are expected to dual (power) record and to make analysis publicly available on ZwiftPower; they must also be using a direct drive trainer or power meter.
**Elite level performances are also expected to be supported by dual (power) recordings from reputable power sources or easily verifiable outside data. This applies to those with a history of such performances.
** 5.2 w/kg (20 mins); 6 w/kg (5 mins); 9.8 w/kg (1 min)
Zwift Activities must be saved publicly.
Please also maintain an open and active Strava profile to facilitate organiser inquiry.
Please see http://www.zwiftpower.com for finalised race results. The race is brought to you by NoPinz please visit https://nopinz.com/product-tag/subzero/ All subzero kit can be custom made in any design.

name: PACK🐺 Banded Buddies
description:
Join the PACK for some fun weekend adventures on a wide variety of routes as we go badge hunting! This event is banded so everyone at any fitness level is welcome. As long as you turn those pedals you will stay with the group and even if you have a dropout, the sweep team will do its best to help you back to the group. You can sign up early via the web or mobile app and late join is enabled.

All riders will appear in the same kit (unlocked at the finish) and you can optionally add (PACK) after your name to show support of the group. Please visit the Coffee Shop if you need a break especially on longer climbs. #coffeetogether 😊

description: SISU Racing is one of Zwift’s most prominent and respected racing teams, known for grit, consistency, and a strong community. Ride at your own pace, stay steady, and log quality miles while a SISU Racing ride leader keeps the group motivated. Whether you’re training for racing, events, or long-term fitness, this is the perfect way to grow endurance, confidence, and resilience—together. Join us and put in the work, SISU style. name: LGBTQz Ride with Pride
description:
We invite everyone to join LGBTQ Zwifters and friends as we Ride with Pride all
year round. Our Sunday social ride is all about togetherness and most rides will use the rubber band so we can be one big, joyful bunch where everyone belongs. No surges, no stress, no getting left behind.  Our rides are inclusive and chat may involve LGBTQIA+ topics so please come with an open heart and open mind. 


You can check whether the rubber band will be in use by clicking the ‘Toggle Event Details’ link at the end of the event description on zwift.com.

Ride proud, ride together, and let’s make the miles brighter.

If you want to learn more about our Club, please visit: https://lgbtq-zwifters.com/

name: EVO CC Race Series
description:
CATEGORY ENFORCEMENT IS ENABLED FOR ALL EVO RACES!

What is Category Enforcement? 

Category Enforcement will prevent Zwifters from entering a category they are not eligible for.  Our goal is to increase fairness in racing.

HOW DOES IT WORK?

- Zwift checks a racer's past performance using VO2 max and FTP to determine their race category.
- Racers can join a category at or above their category. For example, if you are "C" category, you can race in C, B, or A category. You will not be able to race in the D category and the option to join will be absent.

Welcome to EVO race series. Shorter more compact races for the rider looking for an effective high intensity race. Start fast, hang on in the middle, then sprint for the win at the finish. Expect to push your heart rate to its maximum. Sprinkle a few of these into your training plan and watch your fitness grow.

To make racing as fair as possible we have enforced a few minor rules that will result in automatic disqualification on ZwiftPower.

All riders must wear a heart rate monitor
Riding in an incorrect category.

zPower riders will be disqualified in A, B, and C Podium. zPower is allowed in the D category. Race details and final results will be available at www.zwiftpower.com

#evo

name: SUNDAY SUFFERFEST - BLAME STIG!
description:
Every Sunday. Intervals, suffering & absolutely no accountability.  

Welcome to Stig’s weekly exercise in psychological warfare!  

INTERVALS ARE MANDATORY. SURVIVAL IS OPTIONAL. 

Expect brutal efforts, questionable recovery periods, screaming legs and several deeply personal conversations with your smart trainer. 

Stig calls it training. Your legs call it attempted murder.  

Ride together. Suffer together. Question your life choices together.  

If your FTP drops — BLAME STIG.  
If your legs explode — BLAME STIG.  
If you see God during the final interval — tell Him Stig sent you. 

NO MERCY. NO EXCUSES. NO REFUNDS.  

Clip in, sinners. Sunday school is in session. 

THE INTERVALS ARE REAL. THE SUFFERING IS REAL. STIG'S REMORSE IS NOT. 

#BLAMESTIG

name: Seattle Baby Steps 1.0-1.3 w/kg
description:
Are you looking for a supportive beginner or recovery ride?  If so welcome to Seattle Baby Steps! This weekly ride will be paced at an average of 1.0-1.3 w/kg on the flats and is intended for riders who are newer, younger, older, and recovering from injuries.  This is an enjoyable and conversational social ride where your participation is encouraged.  Baby Steps' goal is to help you build strength and confidence to try the hundreds of advanced rides, races, and events that are available every week on Zwift.

We haven't jumped on to the Discord bandwagon yet but join us on our Facebook page at: Seattle Baby Steps - Weekly Zwift Group Ride to stay in touch with the group and to share your thoughts and ask Zwift and other cycling-related questions. https://www.facebook.com/search/top/?q=seattle%20baby%20steps%20-%20weekly%20zwift%20group%20ride

GROUP RIDE ETIQUETTE FOR NEWCOMERS

Please respect the ride leader's pace and instructions. This is not a race and the ride leader will not chase anyone riding off the front of the group. If you feel the need to stretch your legs, do so on the sprints and then prepare to regroup immediately afterward. Faster riders are encouraged to sweep in the back to assist less strong riders who may be struggling to rejoin the group after sprints and inclines. Sprinkle Ride Ons far and wide to encourage and delight your fellow riders! Join in on the conversation (on-screen text), but be mindful of the younger folks (i.e., children) who join the ride from time to time.

name: Chaser the Pacer!
description:
This is a different type of chase event.

Everyone has to complete one lap of Mountain Mash - only 5.7km.

Every category is led by a Robo Pacer, configured so that their power output is at the top end of the pace group. They are all set up so that they should finish *extremely* closely together.

name: OTR Snap Crackle Pop Punch Time
description:
Snap Crackle Pop Punch Time is a group ride, race & interval training all rolled into one fun challenging event. Unique “race” scoring, where results in ZwiftPower are based on sum of segment times on a route with punchy climbs and/or sprints. Group rides together at ~2wkg, and ride leader provides guidance and lead-outs to smash a segment; then regroup, rinse & repeat. New route every week.

Multiple time slots on Fri-Sun, including Fri Atlantic, Sun APAC and Sun Americas/EMEA.
Riders need to join ZwiftPower.com to see their results as sum of segment times.

Event links: https://www.zwift.com/events/tag/snapcracklepop
Weekly results (across all time slots): https://zwiftpower.com/league.php?id=2656
In-ride conversation (“SCP Ride” channel): https://discord.gg/B52qdExaW2
Chat, banter and results: https://discord.gg/HNzvx98srF

Group ride with all cats together at ~2w/kg. Yellow beacon / ride leader (when present) will provide instructions for each segment, and drop the fence when it's time to punch/sprint. Fence is for guidance only (non-zapping).

Ride at a relaxed pace between the timed segments.
Work together to optimize draft for faster segment times.
Slow or stop with yellow beacon after each segment to regroup.

All categories start in a single pen.
Results split per WKG category in ZwiftPower.
No power ups, default drafting, no TT bikes.

One of our regular SCP routes is 3.5 laps of Innsbruckring, with 4x Leg Snappers plus 3x sprints (stopping to regroup on the kicker in between). The challenge is to achieve sub 4 mins for the sum of 7 segment times for cats A/B (that's 45 secs per snapper plus 20 secs per sprint), sub 5 mins for cat C, and sub 7 mins for cat D. Best time to beat is 3:33.
Historical results for Leg Snapper: https://zwiftpower.com/league.php?id=1322

name: Velos Bumper Chase Race
description:
'Bumper' races prepare horses for the biggest events, so why not cyclists? And the name 'Chase' means 'to hunt' in old French, so join Velos for our newest event: 'The Bumper' Chase Race! We change courses weekly to keep it fresh, some weeks flat & others hilly... something for every taste.

A chase-style race is loads of fun because you work with others in your CAT to try and stay ahead of the faster riders. Wait for your group’s horn to sound: Ds take off first, then staggered starts release the Cs, Bs, and As from their pens with increasingly harder efforts required. If the group behind catches you, try to work with them to the finish. Each CAT wears a different kit, making it easier to see the group you are working to catch. Chase races help you learn how to work WITH a team, since a tighter bunch means a faster group. You will master team racing skills and get stronger whilst having fun along the way: the winning formula for ALL Velos events!

Join us at teamvelos.co.uk

Welcome to our VirtuSlo 4Endurance Race. 
The Rules are simple: finish as fast as possible and have Fun!


PEN -> Zwift Racing Score

- No TT Bikes

- Heart Rate Monitor required.
- No Indoor Bikes without Controlled Resistance (Cadence=Power)
- Sticky Watts or unusual pedalling technique to get an unrealistic advantage will result in DQ

- Zwift Activities must be saved PUBLIC for verification.
- Elite Level Performances above the limits stated below must be supported by DUAL POWER Recordings uploaded to Zwiftpower and with margin off error of less than 4%. Outside KOM efforts on Strava can be used for verification of Dual Power analysis.
*MEN: above 4.8W/kg or 350W for 20min, 5.5W/kg or 425W for 5min, 9W/kg for 1min.
**WOMEN: above 4.5W/kg or 280W for 20min, 5W/kg or 325w for 5min, 7.5W/kg for 1min.

description:
Zapraszamy na wspólny event z ZTPL Cycling Club. Pamiętajcie o wyborze właściwej grupy.
Po ukończonym evencie, jeśli jechaliście z nami pierwszy raz, w Waszym wirtualnym garażu będzie czekała nasza teamowa koszulka!

👉Podoba się Wam to co robimy?
Zawsze możecie postawić Waszym kochanym administratorom oraz liderom naszych jazd wirtualną kawę https://buycoffee.to/ztplcc

◾️Grupa E jest grupą dla najbardziej początkujących. Tempo będzie dostojne 😊 i będzie oscylowało w okolicach 1.3-1.7 w/kg
◾️Grupa D jest grupą początkującą. Tempo jest spokojne, uczymy się jazdy w grupie, jest czas żeby porozmawiać. Tempo będzie nieco wyższe niż w grupie E w granicach 1.8-2.5 w/kg
◾️ Grupa C przeznaczona jest dla średnio zaawansowanych. Tempo będzie oscylować w okolicach 2.7-3.2 w/kg z przodu peletonu (możliwe akcenty).
Ważne: Jeśli wasze FTP jest w granicach 2.5w/kg to nie będzie grupa dla Was
◾️ Jeśli chcecie przejechać jazdę w tempie Coffee Ride wybierzcie o jedną grupę niżej niż sugeruje wam wasze FTP lub zwiftpower :)
◾️ Wartości podane w opisach dotyczą średniego tempa z CAŁEJ jazdy (nie uwzględniają interwałów, które mogą wystąpić podczas np. podjazdów)
◾️ PAMIĘTAJCIE że podczas jazd grupowych NIE UŻYWAMY ROWERÓW CZASOWYCH!
◾️ Starajcie się pilnować peletonu i nie zgubić koła, samemu bardzo trudno jest odrobić stratę.
◾️ Proszę słuchajcie poleceń lidera, które podczas jazdy wyświetlane są na środku ekranu.
◾️ Lider, który prowadzi grupę podświetlony jest na żółto.
◾️ Starajcie się jechać blisko lidera, starając się go nie wyprzedać i nie wyjeżdżać przed bramę, która informuje Was że jedziecie za szybko.
Proszę stosujcie się do poleceń lidera!
Szczególnie jeśli lider zauważy że grupa się porwała.

◾️Jeśli chcecie sprawić sobie już teraz naszą nową teamową koszulkę ZTPL Cycling Club zapraszamy bezpośrednio na stronę https://inoni.cc/?s=ztpl&post_type=product
◾️Cała gama naszych koszulek oraz informacje o kolejnych Pre-Orderach znajdziecie na https://ztpl.cc/stroje-ztpl-cc/
◾️Nasze casualowe koszulki znajdziecie u Wintertala: https://wintertal.com/pl/133-ztplcc

#RideOn #ZTPLCC

[ENG]
We would like to invite you to ZTPL Cycling Club Coffee Ride.
In order to ride with Coffee Ride pace, please choose your group wisely.

Our rides are usually led by leaders who help keep the peloton in check. If there is no leader during the event, try to stick to the pace we agreed on when you joined the selected group.
◾️Group E is for total beginners with easy pace at around 1.3-1.7 wk/g
◾️Group D is a beginner group. The pace is calm, we learn how to ride in a Zwift peleton with 1.8-2.5 w/kg pace
◾️Group C is between group D and more advanced Group B. Pace 2.7-3.2 w/kg.
Important: If your FTP is around 2.5w/kg, this group will not be for you

◾️Please listen to the leader’s commands which are displayed in yellow during the whole ride. The leader who leads the group is highlighted in yellow. Please don’t pass the leader.
◾️Please follow the leader instructions! Especially if the leader notices that the group has been swept away. The leader is highlighted in yellow.
◾️At the and wait for the leader’s command: GOGOGO and start your sprint. Enjoy!

◾️If you would like to get yourself our ZTPL Cycling Club team jersey please visit our shop https://inoni.cc/en/?s=ztpl&post_type=product
or you can order our Casual T-Shirt and Hoodies https://wintertal.com/en/133-ztplcc

name: German Cycling Social Ride (Rubberband)
description:
„German Cycling“-Community-Ausfahrt

Mach mit bei der „German Cycling“-Community und fahr mit uns auf Zwift!
Die GC-Tour ist eine offene Gruppenfahrt für alle, die gemeinsam Rad fahren möchten.

Um unserem Verein beizutreten und alle unsere tollen Veranstaltungen zu sehen, klicke bitte hier: https://www.zwift.com/clubs/0d4f7c54-3999-4939-ace9-2223f7a2c55e

🚴 Offen für alle Radfahrer
🚴 Kein Rennen – entspanntes Gruppentempo
🚴 Gemeinschaft und die Freude am Radfahren
Die GC Rides bringen die digitale Zwift-Community mit dem Breitensport von German Cycling zusammen.
Donnerstags findet weiterhin die offizielle vRTF-Punktefahrt statt, die von German Cycling organisiert wird.
Bei den GC Rides dreht sich alles um Motivation, Geselligkeit und gemeinsames Radfahren.

name: Stage 4 - Race - Tour of Watopia 2026 | Advanced
description:
Once a Year. Twice the XP.

New levels are here, and Double XP is the fastest way to reach them. Take on five epic stages throughout Watopia and earn Double XP along the way. It’s your chance to explore brand-new routes, unlock iconic rewards, and stack bonus XP on top of the Double XP while you’re at it.

STAGE 1

Stage 5

Distance: 20.8 km // 12.9 miles
Elevation: 245 meters // 804 ft

MONTHLY GC COMPETITION

Looking for extra motivation? The GC (General Classification) Competition lets you track your progress across all stages. Each race counts—your times add up throughout the series, shaping the overall standings. At the end of the month, the fastest total time takes the win!

VIEW RESULTS: http://zwift.com/racing/leagues/tourofwatopia2026
—------------------
Zwift Racing Score is aimed at pairing you with riders of similar racing abilities to keep racing fun, fair, and competitive. Read the FAQ here: https://support.zwift.com/en_us/racing-score-faq-BkG9_Rqrh

ADVANCED CATEGORY = 650+
CATEGORY RANGE 1 = 0-159 | 160-269 | 270-389 | 390-509 | 510-649
CATEGORY RANGE 2 = 0-209 | 210-329 | 330-449 | 450-569 | 570-724
WOMEN'S EVENTS = Dedicated women's races available throughout the series.

For riders with a Racing Score of 650 or higher, the' Advanced' category will have separate events scheduled every other hour.

Please note that in order to enter the Advanced category, you will need the following:
Heart Rate Monitor
Zwift Racing Score of over 650
Smart Trainer/Bike or Power Meter

Hourly racing will be split into five tighter categories for more exciting competition. Plus, with hourly alternating category ranges, you’ll have more options to find races that suit your level.

name: Sunny & Sweet: Chill Ride by Zabi
description:
🇪🇸 🚴‍♂️☀️ SWEET & SUNNY CHILL RIDE by ZABI 🍩

¿Domingo por la tarde?

El sofá te está llamando… 🛋️Pero también te está llamando Zwift. 😎🚴‍♂️

Bienvenidos a la Sweet & Sunny Chill Ride by ZABI, un recorrido en grupo para disfrutar de unos kilómetros, charlar, reírnos un rato y pasar una buena tarde pedaleando juntos.

No es una carrera.No es un entrenamiento secreto.Y nadie está intentando descubrir quién es el próximo Pogačar. 😂

Solo queremos pasarlo bien en compañía.

🗺️ EL RECORRIDO

El recorrido está preparado y nos espera. 🚴‍♂️

Habrá kilómetros tranquilos, algún repecho y probablemente alguna subida que nos haga pensar:

“Bueno… esto no estaba en mis planes.” 😂

Y quizá aparezca algún sprint espontáneo.

Pero recuerda:

CHILL. RIDE.

Si de repente vas a 500 W…

👉 Nosotros no hemos visto nada. 👀😂

🧲 RUBBERBAND ON — KEEP TOGETHER

La idea es sencilla:

Rodamos juntos.

El ritmo se adapta al grupo, esperamos cuando hace falta y nadie se queda solo.

¿Hoy tienes piernas? Genial. 💪¿Hoy tus piernas están de vacaciones? También genial. 😂

Hay sitio para todos.

🍩 LAS REGLAS NO ESCRITAS

❌ Cero presión❌ Cero guerras de vatios❌ Cero necesidad de demostrar nada❌ Tomarnos demasiado en serio

✅ Buen ambiente✅ Mucho chat 💬✅ Muchas risas 😂✅ Kilómetros compartidos 🚴‍♀️🚴‍♂️✅ Compañerismo 🤝✅ Algún pique amistoso… porque somos ciclistas 😜

🎶 Así que deja el sofá durante un rato, enciende el rodillo y vente a Zwift.

Porque el domingo puede ser:

🛋️ “Hoy descanso.”

O puede ser:

☀️🚴‍♂️ “Bueno, una horita tampoco hace daño.” 😂

SWEET & SUNNY CHILL RIDE by ZABI

Sin presión. Sin carreras. Solo pedaleando juntos. 🧲🚴‍♂️🧡🩵

👇 ÚNETE A LA COMUNIDAD ZABI

🚴 Club ZABI en Zwift:https://www.zwift.com/clubs/ef91fa18-0822-4e53-ba25-3c2d1e2f91b4/home

📸 Instagram:https://www.instagram.com/zabicyclingclub/

📊 Club ZABI en Strava:https://www.strava.com/clubs/2032226/leaderboard

🌐 Web oficial de ZABI:
http://www.zabicycling.com

🇬🇧 🚴‍♂️☀️ SWEET & SUNNY CHILL RIDE by ZABI 🍩

Sunday afternoon?

The sofa is calling… 🛋️But so is Zwift. 😎🚴‍♂️

Welcome to the Sweet & Sunny Chill Ride by ZABI — a relaxed group ride to enjoy some kilometres, have a chat, share a few laughs and spend your Sunday afternoon riding together.

It’s not a race.It’s not a secret training session.And nobody is trying to find out who the next Pogačar is. 😂

We’re just here to have a good time together.

🗺️ THE ROUTE

The route is ready. 🚴‍♂️

There’ll be some easy kilometres, a few bumps and probably a climb that makes you think:

“Well… that escalated quickly.” 😂

And there might even be a completely unnecessary sprint.

But remember:

CHILL. RIDE.

If you suddenly find yourself doing 500 watts…

👉 We saw nothing. 👀😂

🧲 RUBBERBAND ON — KEEP TOGETHER

The idea is simple:

We ride together.

The pace follows the group, we wait when needed and nobody gets left behind.

Feeling strong today? Great. 💪Legs not really cooperating? Also great. 😂

There’s room for everyone.

🍩 THE UNOFFICIAL RULES

❌ No pressure❌ No watt wars❌ No proving anything❌ No taking ourselves too seriously

✅ Good vibes✅ Plenty of chat 💬✅ Plenty of laughs 😂✅ Shared kilometres 🚴‍♀️🚴‍♂️✅ Good company 🤝✅ Maybe a little friendly competition… because we’re cyclists 😜

🎶 So leave the sofa for a while, jump on the trainer and join us on Zwift.

Because Sunday afternoon can be:

🛋️ “I’m resting today.”

Or…

☀️🚴‍♂️ “Well… one little ride won’t hurt.” 😂

SWEET & SUNNY CHILL RIDE by ZABI

No pressure. No racing. Just riding together. 🧲🚴‍♂️🧡🩵

And if someone accidentally launches a sprint…

That was definitely not part of the plan. 👀😂

👇 JOIN THE ZABI COMMUNITY

🚴 ZABI Club on Zwift:https://www.zwift.com/clubs/ef91fa18-0822-4e53-ba25-3c2d1e2f91b4/home

📸 Instagram:https://www.instagram.com/zabicyclingclub/

📊 ZABI Club on Strava:https://www.strava.com/clubs/2032226/leaderboard

🌐 Official ZABI website:
http://www.zabicycling.com

name: EVOLVE 25km Road Race
description:
Join Team Evolve for the EVOLVE 25, an electrifying 25km race on Zwift, utilizing the Zwift Racing Score (ZRS) system to match cyclists of all levels in a dynamic, community-driven virtual peloton. 

This Category Enforced event requires a smart trainer/power meter and heart rate monitor, grouping riders by their ZRS (0-1000 scale), fostering a competitive yet fair atmosphere.

ZRS FAQ: https://support.zwift.com/en_us/racing-score-faq-BkG9_Rqrh

About Us
At Team Evolve, we are more than just a group of athletes we are a dynamic and inclusive community united by our passion for a wide range of activities, both virtual and outdoor. 

Whether you’re into structured training, social rides, running, swimming, or simply staying active in any form, you’ll discover a welcoming and supportive environment here.

For more information visit our website www.teamevolve.cc and join us on our Discord Server: https://discord.gg/teamevolve

name: ZLDR Sunday 15K Run AYOP
description:
Come join us for a run at your own pace (AYOP) 15k. Can’t go the full distance then come for any distance you choose. This is a flexible run-it-your-way all the way! We love the extra company so join this run, get on your treadmill and get ready!

ZLDR is a group of diverse people, from speed demons to walkers, from people just getting to their first 5k to ultra runners. We are a collective group of supportive and experienced runners and walkers who want to help you set and achieve new goals!

What is Racing Score?

Racing Score is an intuitive system that replaces the traditional categories (A - D) with a 0-1000 scale to reflect your current level, considering various metrics like race performances and power. This score helps Zwift recommend the most competitive band to race in, ensuring a fun, rewarding, and exciting experience as you track your progression throughout your Zwift racing adventures.

name: USMeS Operational Reach
description:
Welcome to USMeS Operational Reach.
In military terms, operational reach is the distance and duration a unit can effectively operate before combat power starts to fade, and the supplies start running low. In cycling terms... how long can you keep the legs delivering before they start filing complaints? For the next 90 minutes, we are going to find out! 😈🌋😈

This is a strong, spirited ride built around sustained work with plenty of opportunities to turn up the pressure. The group sets the rhythm, but when the right segment appears, consider that permission to have a little fun.

✅ Ride average watts: 2.2–>2.8 w/kg
✅ Duration: 90 minutes

We push on the climbs and designated segments, so expect the pace to get spicy throughout the ride. Make your move, test the legs, then fall back in quickly. The hard efforts are part of the fun, but keeping the group moving together is always the priority.

Respect the leader. Respect the group.
Work together between the pushes and be ready when it's time to go.

Extend the range. Hold the effort. Complete the mission.

BE LIMITLESS

#conqueringlimits #challengeaccepted #embracethesuck

name: Know No Bounds Ride
description:
Welcome to the #KnowNoBounds Ride! A ride where we explore the boundaries (or lack thereof) on Zwift.
The ride will begin with 30 minutes at 3 w/kg, utilizing the fence to keep riders together. At the end of the 30 minutes, riders are free to do as they please:
they can stay together and explore the chosen course for the day, or they can head off to the nearest mountain with friends and race it!

When the 30 minute "fenced" portion of the ride is over, we will #KnowNoBounds. Have bike, will travel.
If needed, you will be able to turn to ride in opposite direction on the circuit to reconnect with the group quicker (if you need restroom or are dropped),
and most importantly, the group is not limited to the in-game courses. We can choose to go up a mountain, along a riverside, or any road we want to!

We’re on a mission: to set everyday cyclists free to explore without limits. And we’re going by bike.

Community and camaraderie in cycling is everything: group chat on this ride is highly encouraged!

description:
ITT Climbing League where elevation is the target not distance. The clock runs from
Pen to virtual banner finish. The routes have been designed to provide lots of world and
climb variations to keep it interesting and challenging.
Week 1 Max Elevation 250 meters
Week 2 Max Elevation 450 meters
Week 3 Max Elevation 650 meters
Week 4 Max Elevation 850 meters
Week 5 when it rarely happens….Alpe Du Zwift
These races are not like the other KOM segment smash races, racing strategy comes to
play. You will have to work different power ranges, manage energy levels and ponder
bike choices.
• No draft regardless of bike.
• No power up’s just you and your watts.
• Weekly distances will fluctuate, for example week 2 could be 15km and week 3 only
10km, elevation is primary focus.
• Category enforced, must wear HRM.
• Zwift Power league in place for weekly and monthly results. Identical setup to Zwift ITT
Racing. Links below, each month the leagues will be reset. An excel backup is available
on Torturefest Cult discord ITT Climbing room.
• Some weeks will have long lead-ins to the climb which creates the bike choice
dilemma; TT bike, climbing bike or mid race bike change?
• What is the intensity of your effort on each climb in a week where the course has
multiple climbs?
• How do you regulate your power on the flat sections before or between climbs?
One week its long drag climbs, next week its multiple smaller climbs…weekly climbing
Russian roulette style.

name: ZZRC Ride With Friends 1.3-1.5
description:
Welcome to our ZZRC Ride With Friends 1.5. This is a group ride, not a race, where we encourage riding together.

Our rides are open to all riders, the category enforcement merely allows us to ensure a safe and quality ride for you the riders and for our group.

In 2015 ZZRC was founded and are one of the oldest established clubs on Zwift .

YELLOW BEACON will pace between 1.3-1.5. on the ride , with a possible increase of watts on inclines or sprints , but the average for the whole ride will be 1.5

We strongly promote group riding so on most of our rides we will use the Fence to help encourage that. Using a fence ensures that the ride is not over paced .

In the event of falling off the back of the main group , you will need to pace well over group pace to bridge the gap and catch .

This is where our awesome ZZRC sweeps and Ride Buddies will help you return to group using their draft. They will give you clear encouraging instructions to aid this process .

Our crew are a caring bunch who dedicated a lot of hours to this club , but want you to have the best ride experience on Zwift

You will be fully supported and encouraged throughout the ride by the Leader, Sweeps and Ride Buddies .

Our rides do not allow the use of TT Bikes as they do not draft and will require you to push harder on the ride, and in these instances our Sweeps will not be able to help you .

Mountain bikes operate very similarly, minimum draft so more watts (effort) will be required for the ride and any chase backs to group .

All our rides have a 30 minute late join feature which allows you to rejoin if you have technical issues or you find yourself out of the group in the early stages of the ride. Using this feature SHOULD teleport you back into the main group with our YELLOW BEACON .

We love to have a chat on our rides so join us on our dedicated discord channel
https://discord.gg/teHeHABDHc

TOP TIPS
1) Stay close to the ride leader (or just in front on climbs), don’t let a gap form and the elastic snap!
2) Stay away from the Fence – We don’t like to fry anyone
3) Most important of all . . . HAVE FUN AND ENJOY THE RIDE.

#zzrc

Don’t forget to join our ZZRC-We Pace Not Race Facebook page and our club on the companion app

name: TBR Power Up
description:
TBR Power Up is an hour long, all category friendly interval session. There are two intervals at approximately 2.5 watts/kg and one open watts interval.
We recover at our base pace of 1.8 wkg for 10 minutes between each interval.

We roll out at 1.8wkg to group up. Interval 1 is 7.5 minutes at 2.5 w/kg. Interval 2 is 10 minutes at 2.5w/kg. The final interval is The Wild Goose Race with no w/kg limit for 10 minutes to really test your mettle.

We don't use the fence for this ride as we believe all riders should exercise self-control and respect the ride leader by riding with the yellow beacon at all times. Your co-operation helps us provide everyone with a fun, supportive and inclusive ride.
Follow TBR at thebigring.cc to learn more about our events, read ride reports and leave feedback.

name: PACK Run Hill Training: Alpe du Zwift
description:
This event will start on the Road to Sky route and end just 3k up the Alpe climb. There will be a 5k lead in of 0%-1% until we reach the start of the segment and then runners will set their treadmills to 8.5%-9% (depending on TM limitations) and "run" an additional 3km. The average pace to begin will be 10kph, but at 8.5%, it will quickly drop to around 8kph. Each week, there will be an after party, where you can test your ability to get closer and closer to the top. Ultimately, we are preparing you to reach the top, but in order to do that you must transverse the Alpe - 12.2km (7.6 miles) long with over 1,000 meters of elevation gain (approx 3,400 feet) at an average gradient of 8.5%.

This may sound like a daunting task, but that's why we are here. We want to support you in your journey to the top.

If you'd like Zwift to record your elevation, you will either need a treadmill that connects directly to zwift, Runn Smart Treadmill Sensor by North Pole Engineering, or an app like Runcline.

Are you ready?

name: The Grind Finale
description:
ABOUT THIS WORKOUT

This session aims to replicate the demands of a mountain bike ride / event. 

Mountain biking generally involves far more variations in effort compared with road riding - so plenty of surges and time spent being over geared! We also spend a lot of time on and off the power, so short spells going  hard to get over an obstacle, followed by a freewheel or very low power on a descent or little dip.

We touch upon all of these aspects in todays session, as we start off alternating every 30 seconds between riding hard at a low cadence, and riding easy - as if we are riding through an undulating single track. Then we make a ramp in effort, which finishes with a 30 second near max effort up a steep, rocky banking!

WORKOUT DESIGNER

Matt Rowe - Heavily involved in cycling for the past 25 years, Matt represented Great Britain at the Junior World Championships before graduating to the pro ranks. Matt draws on his extensive race experience to help amateur cyclists around the world achieve their personal goals. 

ABOUT GROUP WORKOUTS

Zwifters line up in the starting area just like a normal event and once the event starts, workout mode begins. Everyone stays together regardless of power output. That's right, if you're outputting 100W and another Zwifter is outputting 400W you will stay in exactly the same position relative to each other. Only if you stop pedaling and fall 6 meters behind the group will the rubber-banding stop. 

We highly recommend doing one of the FTP tests as the estimated FTP can be inaccurate and make the difficulty level of the workouts too high for your current fitness level. For more info on FTP go to: https://support.zwift.com/hc/en-us/articles/210208083-What-is-FTP-and-how-is-it-used-in-Zwift

name: EVO CC Sprint Race Series
description:
CATEGORY ENFORCEMENT IS ENABLED FOR ALL EVO RACES!

What is Category Enforcement? 

Category Enforcement will prevent Zwifters from entering a category they are not eligible for.  Our goal is to increase fairness in racing.

HOW DOES IT WORK?

- Zwift checks a racer's past performance using VO2 max and FTP to determine their race category.
- Racers can join a category at or above their category. For example, if you are "C" category, you can race in C, B, or A category. You will not be able to race in the D category and the option to join will be absent.

Welcome to EVO sprintrace series. Shorter more compact races for the rider looking for an effective high intensity race. Start fast, hang on in the middle, then sprint for the win at the finish. Expect to push your heart rate to its maximum. Sprinkle a few of these into your training plan and watch your fitness grow.

To make racing as fair as possible we have enforced a few minor rules that will result in automatic disqualification on ZwiftPower.

All riders must wear a heart rate monitor
Riding in an incorrect category.

zPower riders will be disqualified in A, B, and C Podium. zPower is allowed in the D category. Race details and final results will be available at www.zwiftpower.com

name: HCT Unleashed : Sunday Service
description:
Welcome to HCT Unleashed: Sunday Service.

The week is almost over. Have you paid your dues to the Cycling Gods? This is your final chance to empty the tank and find redemption in a short, sharp Sunday evening sufferfest.

The format is a chaotic mass start, with all categories unleashed at once. But here's the twist: while you can work with—or against—anyone on the course, your official results are only against riders in your own category.

Use the bunch to your advantage. Bridge a gap with a stronger rider or launch a late attack. It’s all part of the game. Join us every week for 20-40 minutes of tactical, high-octane racing.

If you like racing with HCT or are just looking for a racing community to get involved with, join the team on Zwift Power - ""Herts County Triathletes"" https://zwiftpower.com/team.php?id=19017 - and Captain Dan will be in touch to get you set up with the Discord Server. 
On the otherhand if you prefer some less intense involvement HCT also host a Z2 ride @ 3.15pm (GMT) on Saturdays. You can also join the Club on Zwift Companion App, and find us on YouTube, Facebook and Instagram.

Please note; for your results to show up in Zwift Power you must be using a Heart Rate Monitor (HRM) and be riding on a smart trainer, smart bike, or using a power meter.

name: The HERD Sunday Sip and Spin
description:
Hello ladies of Zwift! Come join the Herd ladies as we explore all the flats, hills, and everything in between on this banded ladies only ride.
As long as you keep spinning, at whatever pace you want, we will stay together. Want to tootle along at .5 w/kg? It’s all good. Want to get a high-powered workout in at 3 w/kg? Awesome! You’ll pull us along! Want to do intervals? That works too!
The only time we won’t do a banded ride is when we’re having a sprint practice ride. Otherwise, together we shall stay!
So, grab your favorite drink to Sip and come join us as we Spin further, climb higher and get stronger together!

Don't forget to join us on Discord. Download the app from https://discord.gg/Dr7ZtPV and use the “Ride Audio” channel.
Check out our website: theherd.club for a link to all our rides, Facebook, Strava and our sister racing league.

name: TFC Group Group Ride Sub 2
description:
The TFC ride is open to all riders on Zwift, if you have not already, please opt in to Zwiftpower or you will not be included in the Zwiftpower results screen.
Please follow the yellow beacon who will be the designated ride lead and obey any instructions. Please ensure no TT bikes to benefit from the group draft.
C Group

The sweep team will try to pick up any dropped riders and bring them back to the group if they can hold 2.2-2.3wkg.
During the last lap the ride leader will call for a race to the flag. Wait for the ride leaders’ instructions before you go.

D Group

The D Group will be a Sub 2 W/Kg. The sweep team will pick up dropped riders and bring them back into the main pack. Remember this is the ride average so there will be times the group is slightly above the advertised W/Kg and times when it is below. Listen to the ride lead to ensure everybody is in the main group.

BEWARE - If you do drop off the back of the group you will need to ride at a considerable higher pace to get back to the group. The Sweep teams are there to tow you back on if you do drop off,
We will be on Discord: https://discord.gg/yU6Gkcu
If you’re interested in joining Team TFC please check out: www.facebook.com/groups/teamtfc

name: RollCo: Night Shift
description:
Night Shift is Rolling Collectives after-hours ritual race.

When the lights drop and the noise fades, this is where racing gets raw. Short, sharp courses. Mixed terrain.  No hiding behind long climbs or safe pacing. From the first pedal stroke, it’s on.
Night Shift is built for riders who race on feel and instinct. Attacks come hard, selections happen fast, and hesitation costs you. You don’t wait for the race to start, you make it.

This is late-night racing for those who like it intense, imperfect and alive. All in, after dark.

Why Join Rolling Collective?
We’re more than a club — we’re a global community of riders who support each other, grow together, and celebrate every ride, whether it’s a grind, a badge hunt, or a race. Join us on Discord, connect with fellow riders, and be part of something bigger.

Forward, Together

name: Sunday Funday p/b TBR
description:
Come hang with some friendly peeps on TBR’s D-friendly ride! We roll together in a big, happy bunch at an average 2.0w/kg pace.

We don’t use the fence in favor of control and respect for the ride leader and listed pace. Our rides are fence free and whinge free, if you stick to the leader’s Yellow Beacon like a bear to honey you will enjoy the benefits of a group draft along with lots of friendly banter. We want you to have a happy spin on the bike!

We may be The Big Ring and known for powerful riders, but our tent is also big and we encourage riders comfortable at a social pace to meet our friendly crew and learn about the TBR Effect. We are all about supporting riders in a friendly environment and helping people feel comfortable gradually working up to a faster pace. At TBR, we love to help riders look inside themselves and discover the hidden power within.

Follow The Big Ring (TBR) at www.thebigring.cc

name: JETT Monday Morning Ride (2.5~3.0w/kg)
description:
Welcome to Japan eSports Tempting Team Monday Morning Ride !!
Power : ave 2.5w/kg〜3.0w/kg
Of course, ZWIFTer of all countries can participate. Leaders and heads pull groups at 2.5~3.0w/kg. Riders who are hard at the above power should try grouping by using drafting well.
If you leave the group behind, please offer with ""HELP !!"" and ZWIFT CAHT. Sweeper goes for support. Sweeper will not go for support unless he offers ""HELP !!"". Also, please offer within 10 seconds of time difference as much as possible.

Rule of this group ride
· You always keep grouping in mind( this is not a race )
· Do not Lead from Leader - yellow beacon
· Power Ups allowed ( do not use final Sprint )
· TT Bike allowed
Follow the leader's instructions, let's work together and make the best group, the best workout!

JETT Monday Morning Ride
パワー ave.2.5w/kg〜3.0w/kg
Japan Monday Morning Ride! もちろん、全ての国のZWIFTerが参加できます。 リーダーおよび先頭は2.5〜3.0w/kgでグループを引っ張ります。上記のパワーでは辛いというライダーはドラフティングをうまく活用してグルーピングにトライして下さい。
もし、集団から後方に離れてしまった場合、「HELP!!」とZWIFT CAHTで申し出てください。Sweeperが支援に向かいます。「HELP!!」の申し出がない限り、Sweeperは支援には行きません。また、可能な限りタイム差１０秒以内に申し出をお願いします。
このグループライドのルール
・常にグルーピングを心がけること(レースではありません）
・リーダーの黄色いビーコンよりも前に出ないこと（２０m以上）
・TT Bike OK
・スプリントはリーダー指示に従いましょう
50分のGroup Ride、リーダー指示に従い、みんなで協力して最高のグループ、最高のワークアウトにしましょう！
#JETT
